title: LibScript Embedded & RTOS Synthesis Variables
description: Domain-scoped configuration variables for Zephyr, FreeRTOS, MCUboot signing, and hardware/emulator firmware runners.

LIBSCRIPT_RTOS_BOARD.description: Target Zephyr board or FreeRTOS BSP/simulator port identifier (e.g., qemu_x86_64, qemu_cortex_m3, qemu_riscv64, mps2_an385, riscv_virt, posix_gcc, win32_sim).

LIBSCRIPT_RTOS_HYBRID_POD.description: Flag (0 or 1) enabling hybrid multi-node cloud/unikernel + RTOS edge pod decomposition when multi-process services accompany RTOS targets.

LIBSCRIPT_RTOS_MCUBOOT.description: Flag (0 or 1) enabling MCUboot slot offset compilation and cryptographic imgtool firmware signing.

LIBSCRIPT_RTOS_RUNNER.description: Target runner selected by workloads/schedulers/rtos_firmware.{sh,cmd} (qemu, renode, or openocd).
